$schema: Test coverage manifest for the affiliated-college website and administration system. Update alongside any test work. Never remove or weaken an entry to make coverage look better than it is (CLAUDE.md rule 10) — change its status honestly instead.

database.description: Phase 2 (database) — Prisma schema, migration, and seed verification. Tracks the data layer directly; the per-module pub-*/adm-* entries below stay not_started until real UI/API code reads from these tables.

items.feature: Prisma schema validates and formats cleanly (39 requested models + supporting tables)
items.notes: `npx prisma validate` and `npx prisma format` both clean against prisma/schema.prisma.

items.feature: Migration applies to a real PostgreSQL database with zero drift
items.notes: PostgreSQL 16 installed locally (Homebrew) since none was available in this environment. Migration SQL generated statically via `prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema=prisma/schema.prisma --script` (prisma/migrations/20260913114324_init_content_modules/), then applied for real with `prisma migrate deploy` — succeeded. `prisma migrate diff --from-config-datasource --to-schema=prisma/schema.prisma --exit-code` confirms zero drift afterward.

items.feature: Seed script populates one demo record per module and is idempotent
items.notes: `npx prisma db seed` run twice against the real database; row counts unchanged on the second run (all upserts). Seeds baseline roles, one placeholder college, one [DEV SEED] admin user, one [PLACEHOLDER] demo record per content module, and all 20 ComplianceRequirement rows transcribed from docs/compliance-matrix.md.

items.feature: ComplianceRequirement -> ComplianceEvidence -> ComplianceVerification human-decision flow works and is not auto-derived
items.notes: Seeded one ComplianceEvidence + one ComplianceVerification (decision=VERIFIED) for requirement #4 (Faculty), then updated that requirement's status to VERIFIED. Verified via psql that only item #4 is VERIFIED and all other 19 remain NOT_STARTED (CLAUDE.md rule 7). No automated code path derives this status from evidence alone yet — that's the Phase 3+ approval workflow's job.

items.feature: Existing app code still typechecks/lints/passes tests against the new generated Prisma Client
items.notes: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test` all clean after the schema change (15/15 unit tests).
